description: This file defines the CsrfTokenManager class in the OrangeHRM project, which manages CSRF tokens using Symfony's security components. It extends the base CsrfTokenManager, incorporates a trait for service container functionality, and provides methods for token validation. It primarily facilitates CSRF protection within the authentication plugin of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: CsrfTokenManager
classes.description: A class that manages CSRF tokens, extending Symfony's CsrfTokenManager to include project-specific integrations and validation methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CSRF token manager, retrieving the token storage from the service container and passing it along with a new token generator to the parent constructor.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates a CSRF token against the stored token data using Symfony's isTokenValid method.
